tags.name: walkable
tags.description: People can stand and walk on its top (floors, ramps, stairs, landings).

tags.name: obstacle
tags.description: Blocks people and lines of sight (walls, pillars, barriers, ad stands).

tags.name: escalator
tags.description: Moving steps or walkway: a ramp or stairs carries people up its slope (a flat box is a travelator), in two lanes. Whether people stand or walk is behaviour (SetEscalatorStyle).

tags.name: escalator:down
tags.description: Runs down the slope instead of up.

tags.name: emergency
tags.description: An emergency route (fire stairs, exit doors): closed to everyday routing; only people whose behaviour uses emergency routes (UseEmergencyRoutes) go through it.

tags.name: attention
tags.description: Something people may look at (an ad, a sign, an exit): a thin box whose large face is measured against every person's gaze. See the Attention panel.

tags.name: attention:salience
tags.description: How eye-catching it is: bright, backlit or moving is high, a printed poster lower.

tags.name: attention:range
tags.description: How far its zone reaches: people within it have an opportunity to see it.

tags.name: area:
tags.description: Names a region (area:alley) for scripts and reports to refer to.
